_source: CPI Brand Identity Standards & Master Style Guide — Bangladesh Mission
_note: These are the ONLY approved colors. Never introduce a color outside this list into any CPI material.

cpi_red.usage: Primary accent, Heading 1, key buttons, callout borders, header rules

cpi_purple.usage: Logo mark, Heading 2/3, table headers, cover backgrounds, dark panels

cpi_black.usage: Body narrative text, table cell contents, high-contrast digital reading

cpi_mid_grey.usage: Captions, image credits, table gridlines (0.5pt), footer text

cpi_blue_teal.usage: WASH & Clean Energy focus, chart series 3, secondary callout badges

cpi_secondary_purple.usage: Chart visualization series 2, secondary structural callouts

cpi_light_grey.usage: Alternating table row fills (at 30% opacity), background card panels

office_digital_workspace_docs._note: Use this family inside Google Docs/Sheets/Slides — Raleway is for designed/printed collateral (posters, PDFs), not native Workspace documents.

logo_rules.clear_space: Equal to the x-width of the letter 'P' in the CPI logo, on all four sides
logo_rules.on_brand_color_background: white reversed logo (CPI Purple, CPI Red, or CPI Black backgrounds only)
never: rotate, distort, or stretch the logo
change the logo colors or apply drop shadows
place the logo on top of busy photos or unapproved colors
